home.lead: Petrel speaks JMAP, IMAP and POP3. It’s fast, private by default, made for the keyboard, and yours to self-host as a single binary.
home.f1: JMAP for speed, IMAP and POP3 for everything else, SMTP for sending. One inbox for all of them.
home.f2: Remote images and trackers are blocked until you say so. Credentials are encrypted at rest.
home.f3: Gmail-style shortcuts, a command palette, and instant actions with undo.
home.f4: One Go binary with SQLite next to it. Light and dark themes, density settings, English and German.
home.footer: Open source under the MIT license. Built with {tern}.
